name: @letta-ai/muscle-memory
description: Letta Code mod: a self-evolving skill foundry. A reflective reviewer distills CLASS-LEVEL skills from CROSS-CONVERSATION recall (not one session), routes update-first via MemFS search (anti-bloat), filters env-noise, runs a staged fork autopilot + curator, and learns failure defenses — all reversible, gated, and receipted. Benchmarked above Hermes's own review prompt on output quality + ability.
author: Adrian Chan

scripts.test: npx --yes esbuild mods/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/muscle-memory-package-test.mjs && node scripts/validate.mjs && npm run integration
scripts.demo:record: asciinema rec docs/demo.cast --overwrite -c 'node scripts/demo-reel.mjs' && agg --theme dracula --font-size 22 docs/demo.cast docs/demo.gif
